texts.preamble: Pappu Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 31 August, 2016 Author: Anant Bijay Singh Bench: Anant Bijay Singh In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi A.B. A. No. 2364 of 2016 Pappu Kumar ...... Petitione Versus The State of Jharkhand ...... Opposite Party --------- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anant Bijay Singh --------- For the Petitioner : Mr. Shashi Kant Thakur, Advocate For the State : A.P.P. --------- 04/Dated: 31/08/2016 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the Stat
texts.facts: The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with the case registered under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act. Pursuant to the order dated 26.08.2016 record of Cr.M.P No. 1264 of 2016 was called for the same has been received. It appears that Cr.M.P No. 1264 of 2016 has been filed by the petitioner 07.06.2016 for quashing the order taking cognizance under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act.
texts.arguments: From perusal of the record that learned A.C.J.M., has taken cognizance under Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act. 59- Any person who whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf, manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any article of food for human consumption which is unsafe, shall be punishable: (i) Where such failure or contravention does not result in injury, with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months and also with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees; (ii) Where such failure or contravention result in a non-grievous injury with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and also with fine which may extend to three lakh rupees. (iii) Where such failure or contravention results in a grievous injury with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six years and also with fine which may Pappu Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 31 August, 2016 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143243287/ 1 extend to five lakhs rupees. (iv) where such failure or contravention results in death, with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and also with fine which shall not be less than ten lakh rupees.
